reviews.title: 9 Years of Loyalty Betrayed: Alibaba Chose a Dishonest Supplier Over a Trusted Buyer”
reviews.text:
After more than nine years of doing business through Alibaba, I am deeply disappointed with how the company handled my recent dispute.

A supplier significantly delayed my shipment, causing the merchandise to lose its commercial value during the World Cup season. During the dispute, I believe the supplier made false statements, and I submitted extensive evidence to support my position.

Despite the evidence I provided, Alibaba decided in favor of the supplier and denied my $198 refund.

Let me be clear: This is not about $198. That amount is insignificant compared to the business my company has conducted through Alibaba over the past nine years.

What truly disappoints me is that Alibaba appeared to give greater weight to the supplier’s statements than to the evidence I submitted as a long-standing buyer.

I am not asking for special treatment. I expect honesty, fairness, accountability, and respect in business relationships.

After more than nine years of loyalty, Alibaba’s handling of this dispute has destroyed my trust in its buyer protection system.

Alibaba did not simply lose a $198 dispute. It lost a long-term business customer.

I have decided to end my business relationship with Alibaba and take my company’s future business elsewhere.

Customer loyalty should never be taken for granted.

reviews.title: Alibaba’s buyer protection is a joke.
reviews.text:
Alibaba’s buyer protection is a joke. I had an issue with a supplier who sent an incomplete order with significantly lower-quality products, and neither the seller nor Alibaba took responsibility. I received no refund whatsoever.

The app made everything worse. Every time I tried to report the issue or submit evidence proving the seller had failed to deliver what I paid for, the system mysteriously failed. I tried repeatedly, but my evidence would not go through.

Even more frustrating, the app also seemed to fail when I tried to leave a negative review. Funny how the system keeps failing when you need to report a problem or hold someone accountable.

My purchase was supposedly protected, but when I actually needed that protection, it was nowhere to be found. What is the point of buyer protection if customers cannot even submit their evidence properly?

Between the supplier’s poor service, Alibaba’s failure to resolve the dispute, and an app that repeatedly failed when I tried to report the problem, this has been an absolutely terrible experience.

I lost money, time, and trust in this platform. I will never use Alibaba again, and I do not recommend this platform to anyone.

reviews.title: Return Issue
reviews.text:
Alibaba, I am extremely disappointed with your return process and customer service.

What Alibaba says about its return policy and what customers actually experience are two completely different things. When a customer wants to return an item, finding the return option in the app can be extremely difficult, and in some cases it feels almost impossible to complete the return process.

What is even more frustrating is the Live Chat support. Instead of helping resolve the problem, customers are sometimes asked questions such as whether the payment was made to Alibaba or directly to the seller. This is unacceptable when the payment was made through Alibaba’s own platform and through the payment link provided by Alibaba.

As a customer, I should not have to spend hours searching through the app or explaining to customer service how I made a payment through Alibaba’s own system just to return an item that I purchased.

If Alibaba advertises a return policy, the return process should actually be easy to find and use. Customer support should help customers solve problems—not make the process even more confusing and frustrating.

This experience has seriously damaged my trust in Alibaba. I strongly recommend that Alibaba review its return system and customer service process and make them transparent, accessible, and genuinely customer-friendly.

reviews.title: Money Back Protection - Lies - 18K Down
reviews.text:
I purchased a custom trailer from a supplier on Alibaba. After waiting over a year for the product, I was informed—right after shipment—that they had forgotten to include several items. I was understandably unhappy and requested a refund for those missing items through Alibaba’s portal, but I was told to wait until the trailer arrived.

After waiting more than 60 days, the trailer finally arrived, and it was nowhere near what I had ordered. The serving window was installed in the wrong location, many parts were in poor condition, and the roof leaked from day one. It was obvious they had tried to cover the issue with duct tape before shipping it.
I reported everything to Alibaba immediately and kept them updated throughout the entire process. Despite providing photos, videos, and detailed explanations, they repeatedly asked for more evidence. To strengthen my case, I even hired a third-party inspector, whose report confirmed that the trailer was not usable and that the build quality was far below acceptable standards.
Even with all the evidence and the inspector’s report, Alibaba continued giving me the runaround until the timeframe for recovering funds through the bank had passed. Their final response was that they could not determine whether the trailer was already in poor condition when shipped or whether the issues were caused after installation.

Lesson learned: if you ever experience something similar, contact your bank immediately and request a chargeback. Because Aliba

reviews.title: Zero stars if only I could.
reviews.text: Cluttered and Overwhelming UI: The app is a visual nightmare. From the moment you open it, you're bombarded with intrusive pop-ups, flashing ads, and "silly games" that feel more like a digital casino than a shop. Useless Search & Navigation: Finding specific items is nearly impossible. The search engine is "pointless," often ignoring filters or showing completely unrelated results to what you actually typed. Deceptive Pricing: Listed prices often change once you add an item to your cart, with hidden shipping fees suddenly making the "deal" much more expensive than local alternatives. The Customer Service Abyss: If anything goes wrong, you are stuck with automated bots that provide "copy and paste" responses. The dispute process is a frustrating multi-step ordeal where legitimate refund requests are often rejected despite clear evidence of wrong or missing items. Buggy Experience: The app frequently hangs, crashes, or fails to update order tracking, requiring constant restarts or re-installations just to function. Bottom Line: Unless you have hours to waste navigating a broken interface and fighting for a fiver refund, avoid this app and stick to more reliable platforms.

reviews.title: ‘’Trade assurance’’ advice
reviews.text:
Alibaba’s guarantee does not fully protect your rights, even if you provide proof and even when the supplier admits the issue. Suppliers know that the Alibaba platform tends to protect them because they generate high profits for it. They also try to prolong the process by extending the number of days to make you feel frustrated and push you to look for any way to get a refund or cancel the transaction.

There are ways to obligate suppliers, such as using third-party product inspection services. You can find these services and agree with them after manufacturing. Another method is to establish clear contractual clauses and get the supplier to explicitly agree to them in the chat. I know many suppliers will refuse, because they are not confident in their production quality and may even use lower quality materials to reduce their costs.

They are clever when it comes to manipulating these matters. Therefore, I advise you to use these methods to avoid such problems. Another piece of advice: even if a supplier has a high rating and tells you they guarantee the required quality, do not trust them blindly. They also manipulate wording. I have had many experiences with them, so I am sharing these tips to help you avoid these problems.
